AI Startups Secure Significant Funding Rounds

Several artificial intelligence startups have announced substantial funding rounds. Mantic, an AI company focused on forecasting, has raised $25 million. Angle Health, another AI startup, has secured $600 million at a valuation of $2.7 billion. Additionally, Manus, an AI startup, is reportedly seeking to raise $500 million and is considering a Hong Kong initial public offering.
